post_title: What rating will MasterChef Celebrity (Telefe) record for its Thursday, November 26, 2026 broadcast?

question.title: What rating will MasterChef Celebrity (Telefe) record for its Thursday, November 26, 2026 broadcast?
question.description:
MasterChef Celebrity is Telefe's prime-time celebrity cooking competition, produced by Telefe and Boxfish and hosted by Wanda Nara. The current (fifth) season premiered on Monday, September 28, 2026 at 22:15 (Argentina time), streaming simultaneously on HBO Max, and airs Sunday to Thursday in the ~22:15 slot with about 90 minutes of programming on weeknights and a 24-celebrity line-up; the previous season concluded on March 19, 2026.

Argentine viewership is measured by Kantar Ibope Media and quoted as "rating points" (percentage of AMBA households). The industry portal television.com.ar publishes a daily per-channel ranking of most-watched programs sourced from Ibope, and that ranking is the resolution source here. Recent marks for the main "MasterChef Celebrity" broadcast: 12.1 on Monday, October 12; 11.7 on Monday, November 2; 12.2 on Tuesday, November 3 (the "última chance" gala); 11.4 on Monday, November 9; 13.4 on Wednesday, November 11 (the night after Julieta Nair Calvo's elimination, with the companion show measuring 10.5); and 12.6 on Thursday, November 12, 2026 (see https://television.com.ar/noticias/ratings/ratings-del-jueves-12-de-noviembre-estos-fueron-los-programas-mas-vistos-de-cada-canal-de-la-tv-abierta-2026-11-12/). Press coverage of the Thursday, November 5 gala cited a peak ("pico") of 14 points at 22:38 — a momentary peak, not the program average — which is why this question is anchored to the daily report's program-level number.

The show comfortably dominates its slot: on November 12, no Eltrece program exceeded 5.5 points (Telenoche 5.5, "Otro día perdido" 5.0), while Telefe's full-day average of 7.4 far outpaced Eltrece's 4.4. Telefe's grid has been volatile this season: the Wednesday, September 30 episode was lifted, and programming was reshuffled around Pope Leo XIV's visit to Argentina in early November, when the Sunday gala was pushed to 22:15 behind papal coverage and the Monday and Tuesday schedules were altered. Off-screen, the legal dispute between Wanda Nara and Mauro Icardi has dominated entertainment coverage and, per press reports, has not been well received at the channel; ousted contestant Julieta Nair Calvo accused the jury of favouring some participants; and reports suggest jury member Damián Betular may leave the show.

As of November 10, 18 of the 24 contestants remained (six eliminated: Pachu Peña, Paula Trápani, Morena Beltrán, Alejandro Lerner, Diego Ramos and Julieta Nair Calvo), with eliminations generally falling on Tuesdays. With roughly one elimination per week and no announced end date, the season is expected to still be running on Thursday, November 26, 2026, though pre-emption or schedule changes remain a possibility (such a case would annul the question).

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the rating-points figure published for the Telefe program "MasterChef Celebrity" in the daily ratings report of television.com.ar (a ranking compiled from Kantar Ibope Media measurements) for Thursday, November 26, 2026, found in the site's ratings section: https://television.com.ar/noticias/?categoria=ratings — typically titled "Ratings del jueves 26 de noviembre: estos fueron los programas más vistos de cada canal de la TV Abierta". The resolved value is the single number listed for that program (e.g., a report listing "MasterChef Celebrity 12.4" resolves as 12.4); if that date's report lists more than one Telefe entry whose program name begins with "MasterChef Celebrity" (for instance an after-show such as "MasterChef Celebrity: la definición"), the resolved value is the highest of those figures. If the television.com.ar report for that date is unavailable or contains no figure for such a program, the rating reported for the same broadcast by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) citing Kantar Ibope is used, taking the program's average rather than a momentary peak where both are given. If Telefe does not air a new prime-time episode of MasterChef Celebrity on November 26, 2026 (for example because the show is pre-empted, or because only a rerun or compilation is broadcast), or if no rating figure for such an episode is published, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: Rating points here are Kantar Ibope household rating points for the Buenos Aires metropolitan area (AMBA), the metric quoted in the Argentine press; share ("cuota de pantalla") percentages are not used. The figure used is the one reported for the program's broadcast on the night of Thursday, November 26, 2026 (local time, Buenos Aires).
